name: ghost-media-player-mobile
description: Ghost Media Player, phone edition (Android via Capacitor).

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && node scripts/apply-android-resources.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:build:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
